reason: No prior evidence is cited for any of the key premises; the hypothesis relies entirely on unsupported claims about the effects of a Ni interlayer on W–Cu bonding, wetting, and void reduction, and on the feasibility of ALD Ni coating on W particles.
premises: Ni coating improves W–Cu interfacial bonding
Ni interlayer reduces void formation and phase separation
Ni interlayer enhances wetting and interdiffusion between W and Cu
Ni interlayer lowers interfacial energy mismatch and enhances atomic mobility
ALD can deposit a uniform ~5 nm Ni layer on W particles
